# Installing nvsnap

nvsnap is installed with its Helm chart, `deploy/helm/nvsnap`. This is the
one install guide; every value it names is documented in the chart's
[values.yaml](../../deploy/helm/nvsnap/values.yaml), and what the chart deploys
is described in [ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md#1-what-nvsnap-is-and-what-a-deployment-runs).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Why |
|---|---|
| Kubernetes and Helm 3 | The chart and its subcharts |
| GPU nodes labelled `nvidia.com/gpu.present=true` (GPU Operator), `cloud.google.com/gke-gpu=true` (GKE) or `feature.node.kubernetes.io/pci-10de.present=true` (Node Feature Discovery) | The agent DaemonSet's node affinity (`agent.nodeAffinity`) |
| An NVIDIA driver with the CUDA checkpoint driver API (`cuCheckpointProcess*`); 610 or later for multi-GPU capture under gpushare ([GPUSHARE.md](../design/GPUSHARE.md#requirements-and-limits)) | CRIU capture checkpoints GPU state through it |
| containerd (default) or CRI-O | The agent talks to the runtime's socket (`agent.hostPaths.containerdSock`) and reads its storage directory (`agent.hostPaths.containerdStorage`); `agent.runtime` is informational |
| cgroup v2 | Process discovery and freezing |
| Credentials for the image registry (`nvsnap.imageRegistry`) | Every nvsnap image is pulled from it |

The chart installs cert-manager and the NVIDIA GPU Operator as subcharts by
default. On a cluster that already runs either, turn the subchart off:
`--set cert-manager.enabled=false` or `--set gpu-operator.enabled=false`.

## Install

### Pull secret

Create the namespace and a pull secret named `nvsnap-pull-secret`
(`nvsnap.imagePullSecrets`):

```bash
kubectl create namespace nvsnap-system
kubectl create secret docker-registry nvsnap-pull-secret \
  --namespace=nvsnap-system \
  --docker-server=nvcr.io \
  --docker-username='$oauthtoken' \
  --docker-password='<NGC API key>'
```

`$oauthtoken` is the literal user name NGC expects. Rotation and mirrors are
in [PULL-SECRETS.md](PULL-SECRETS.md).

### Helm install

From a checkout of the repository:

```bash
helm dependency build deploy/helm/nvsnap
helm install nvsnap deploy/helm/nvsnap --namespace nvsnap-system
```

`scripts/install-nvsnap.sh` runs the same steps (it creates the pull secret
from `$NGC_API_KEY` or your `docker login nvcr.io` credentials, and passes
`--set` through to Helm); `--dry-run` renders without applying.

### Verify

```bash
kubectl -n nvsnap-system rollout status ds/nvsnap-agent
kubectl -n nvsnap-system get pods
kubectl get mutatingwebhookconfiguration nvsnap-rootfs-restore
```

The chart's post-install job (`postInstallSmoke`) probes every component and
fails the install when one is unhealthy. Without the webhook registration no
pod is prepared for capture or restore, and every pod starts cold.

## Choose how nvsnap behaves

| Value | Default | What it decides |
|---|---|---|
| `agent.captureMethod` | `cachedir` | `cachedir` captures caches and the model; `criu` captures the processes ([ARCHITECTURE.md §2](../ARCHITECTURE.md#2-the-two-capture-methods-and-how-one-is-chosen)) |
| `agent.criuCaptureOptIn` | `[]` | Under `criu`, which multi-pod instances are captured, by pod label (for example `function-id`) |
| `webhook.injectScope` | `all` | `all` namespaces not labelled `nvsnap.io/inject=false`, or `optIn`: only namespaces labelled `nvsnap.io/inject=true` |
| `agent.modelVolume.enabled` | `false` | One model volume per model per cluster |
| `agent.election.enabled` | `false` | One downloader per hash when a chart starts many workers (cachedir only) |
| `agent.l2.storageClass` | | The StorageClass of the per-checkpoint volume pair; empty keeps checkpoints on their nodes |
| `agent.auth.enabled`, `agent.auth.mode` | `false`, `permissive` | Bearer-token checks on the agent API. Turn on, run `permissive` until no unauthenticated calls are counted, then `required` |
| `server.service.type` | `LoadBalancer` | `ClusterIP` for port-forward access |

## Turning nvsnap off for some or all pods

- One workload: label its pod template or its namespace
  `nvsnap.io/inject=false`.
- Every pod: `helm upgrade ... --reuse-values --set webhook.inject=false`
  removes the webhook registration and nothing else; set it back to `true`
  to resume. Pods admitted while it is off carry nothing of nvsnap.
- `agent.modelVolume.enabled` and `agent.election.enabled` turn off only
  their own mechanism.

## Upgrade

```bash
helm upgrade nvsnap deploy/helm/nvsnap --namespace nvsnap-system --reuse-values
```

The agent DaemonSet rolls one node at a time. An instance capture does not
start while agents run different revisions.

## Uninstall

```bash
helm uninstall nvsnap --namespace nvsnap-system
```

The uninstall deletes the catalog volume `nvsnap-server-db` with the release:
it is a chart object without a keep policy (`templates/server.yaml`).
Checkpoints on the nodes' disks, L2 volumes and model volumes are created by
the agent, not the chart, and are not removed.

## Troubleshooting

### Agent pods stuck in `ImagePullBackOff`

The pull secret is missing from the namespace or holds the wrong key:
`kubectl -n nvsnap-system describe pod <agent pod>`, then recreate it.

### Agent DaemonSet shows 0/0, or pods stuck in `Pending`

No node matches the agent's node affinity, or the matching nodes carry a
taint it does not tolerate:

```bash
kubectl get nodes -L nvidia.com/gpu.present,cloud.google.com/gke-gpu,feature.node.kubernetes.io/pci-10de.present
```

Replace `agent.nodeAffinity` (and, for tainted nodes, `agent.tolerations`)
with ones that match your GPU nodes, in a values file passed with `-f`.

### nvsnap-server external IP is `<pending>` forever

The cluster has no LoadBalancer controller. Use
`--set server.service.type=ClusterIP` and
`kubectl -n nvsnap-system port-forward svc/nvsnap-server 8080:8080`.

### Restored pods start cold

Check, in order: the webhook registration exists (Verify above); the pod's
namespace is covered by `webhook.injectScope`; under `criu`, a multi-pod
instance is opted in; the agent's log on the pod's node, which names why it
did not restore (for example "no capture for hash" or a tenant-scope
mismatch).

## Where things live after install

| Object | Where |
|---|---|
| Agent | DaemonSet `nvsnap-system/nvsnap-agent` |
| Server | Deployment `nvsnap-system/nvsnap-server`, Service port 8080 |
| Catalog | PVC `nvsnap-server-db` (SQLite) |
| Webhook | MutatingWebhookConfiguration `nvsnap-rootfs-restore` |
| Checkpoints on each node | `agent.hostPaths.checkpoints` (default `/var/lib/containerd/nvsnap-checkpoints`) |
| Captured caches and model volumes on each node | `agent.hostPaths.nvsnapCache`, `agent.hostPaths.nvsnapModels` (under `/var/lib/containerd`) |
